task.title: How to link an External Library into X-Author

context.p: After developing an External Action that is part of a library (.NET assembly), load the library into X-Author Designer using the following steps.

step.cmd: Navigate to the X-Author for Designer Tab.
Click External Library, load the required .dll file and click OK.
step.info: After you load the selected assembly, X-Author detects all the external actions within that assembly.

step.cmd: Invoke the newly created external actions within an Action Flow just like built-in actions.
